properties.name: C&C Character Creation Wizard
properties.author: The Kraken
properties.description: A guided character builder for Castles & Crusades on SmiteWorks' Castles & Crusades ruleset (CnCRPG). Abilities - Race - Class - Primes - Hit Points - Equipment - Spells - Finish. The Castle Keeper sets the starting level in Options (Character Wizard); the wizard builds the character at that level. Uses every C&C book you load: races, classes, spells and gear from the Players Handbook, the Adventurer's Backpack or any other book that has them.

announcement.text: C&C Character Creation Wizard 1.0-beta2: open Characters and click the wizard figure to build a character. It uses every C&C book you load (races, classes, spells, gear).
